fusions.name: Staghorn Shatter
fusions.desc: Smashes a reef growth into a cone of shards 3 tiles long, dealing 7 piercing damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Shipwrecker
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Razor Reef
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Storm-Beaten Crust
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
